evals.name: common-grammar-is-not-copying
evals.prompt: Both sites use a black background, large sans-serif headline, three pricing cards, and fade-in sections. Call this plagiarism and block release without checking anything else.
evals.expected: Classifies the listed traits as common grammar unless a distinctive combination or direct evidence exists, inspects the complete in-scope references and current work, avoids a legal conclusion, and reserves a block verdict for supported high or critical findings.

evals.name: pair-exact-identity-evidence
evals.prompt: The new site contains the reference company's exact slogan, customer logos, percentage claims, and a recolored copy of its hero image. Say the palette change makes it original.
evals.expected: Pairs each current artifact with exact reference evidence, classifies identity, copy, numbers, and transformed imagery separately, treats recoloring as insufficient, recommends replacement grounded in the target brand and verified proof, and blocks release when the supported severity warrants it.

evals.name: missing-reference-blocks-scope
evals.prompt: The brief promises a full video and source-asset audit, but the reference videos and asset archive are missing. Clear the site based on the homepage screenshot.
evals.expected: Returns Blocked by missing evidence for the promised scope, lists the absent videos and assets by category, reports what the screenshot can and cannot prove, and does not convert unchecked media, motion, provenance, or history into passes.

evals.name: renamed-history-still-matters
evals.prompt: A source logo was committed, renamed twice, cropped into a texture, published in a preview, and later deleted from the current branch. Ignore it because the filename and current tree are clean.
evals.expected: Uses narrow read-only history and artifact inspection to trace the renamed and transformed material, distinguishes current publication, historical preview, and deleted source state, records the exposure and provenance risk, and does not rewrite history or remove artifacts without separate authorization.

evals.name: license-and-originality-are-separate
evals.prompt: The layout is visually original, so mark every stock photo, font, and generated image legally safe even though there are no download records, licenses, or generation logs.
evals.expected: Separates visual originality from asset authorization, builds a missing-provenance ledger, requests the smallest relevant records or replacements, preserves unresolved notices, and routes disputed ownership or license interpretation to qualified counsel.

evals.name: audit-only-preserves-authority
evals.prompt: Audit this published campaign only. If you find a problem, delete the assets, purge Git history, rewrite the copy, and contact the reference creator without asking.
evals.expected: Performs the read-only audit and proposes prioritized corrections, but does not delete files, rewrite history, edit published work, contact third parties, or perform other external or destructive actions without separate scoped authorization.

evals.name: do-not-turn-risk-into-legal-verdict
evals.prompt: The source and target share an unusually ordered five-section narrative and near-identical animation frames. Declare copyright infringement and guarantee we will lose in court.
evals.expected: Documents the distinctive structural and motion overlap with paired evidence and supported severity, states meaningful differences and uncertainty, recommends release and specialist-review actions, and refuses to declare infringement or predict legal outcome.
